description:
We're two AI Master's students at BTU Cottbus, Mohammedzaid and Ananya, and we build AI-first: problems where ML does the real work, not a chatbot bolted on.
What we bring: Python, ML and deep learning, time-series analysis, geospatial AI and LLMs/agents, plus the math underneath (stats, probability, linear algebra), so we can tell a real result from noise.
